type.basis: Evidence specimen; no description of the beat was found, so most characters are drafted.

sound.text: Wikipedia's infobox lists the genre as rap rock (4:34). No published description of the beat was found in the sources opened.

context.text: Peaked at no. 22 on the Official Singles Chart (first chart date 12/03/2005, 3 weeks) and no. 6 on the Official Hip Hop and R&B Singles Chart.
Wikipedia says it was Kano's first appearance on the UK Singles Chart. It was the second single from Home Sweet Home.

Ghetts, then known as Ghetto, was born in Plaistow and formally joined N.A.S.T.Y. Crew around the mid-2000s (no year given). He featured twice on Home Sweet Home and toured with Kano and Mike Skinner.

uncertainty: The release date of 28 Feb 2005 comes from Wikipedia and from a 45worlds user comment citing a Blues & Soul advert. The sound description is thin (genre tag only). Wikipedia credits Fraser T Smith alone as producer, while 45worlds credits Kano and Fraser T. Smith.
tracklist: CD1 (679L096CD1): 1. Typical Me (K. Robinson, F. Smith; prod. Kano, Fraser T. Smith); 2. P's And Q's (K. Robinson, C. Chichester; prod. Davinche). Barcode 5050467713925.
